sub.en: This, that and that over there: modifiers, places (여기, 거기, 저기) and things (이것, 그것, 저것)
sub.ko: 이·그·저의 거리 기준, 장소 지시(여기·거기·저기), 사물 지시(이것·그것·저것)

desc.en: Free printable Korean worksheet on demonstratives: 이 (near speaker), 그 (near listener), and 저 (far from both) / with modifiers, objects (이것/그것/저것), places (여기/거기/저기), practice and an answer key.

title.en: The Three Distances of 이, 그, 저

rows: 저 (저 사람 = that person over there)
sections.note: 이 refers to what is close to the speaker. 그 refers to what is close to the listener (or already mentioned in conversation). 저 refers to what is visible but distant from both speaker and listener.

title.en: Spoken Contractions of 이것, 그것, 저것

sections.note: In natural spoken Korean, native speakers almost always use the short forms: 이게 뭐예요? (What is this?), 이건 제 거예요 (This is mine), 이걸로 주세요 (Give me this one).

title.en: Using 이, 그, 저 with Nouns

sections.text: Place 이, 그, or 저 directly before any noun without a particle: 이 책 (this book), 그 영화 (that movie you mentioned), 저 건물 (that building over there). To ask 'which', use 어느: 어느 나라 사람이에요? (Which country are you from?).

title.en: Practice A: Choose 이, 그, or 저 based on distance
title.ko: 거리 기준에 맞게 이, 그, 저 중 하나를 골라요

items.q: Object in the speaker's hand: ___ 책 (this book) →
Object right next to the listener: ___ 가방 (that bag near you) →
Distant mountain visible to both: ___ 산 (that mountain over there) →
Building across the street: ___ 건물 (that building over there) →
Food the speaker is currently eating: ___ 음식 (this food) →

title.en: Practice B: Choose place words: 여기, 거기, 저기
title.ko: 여기, 거기, 저기 중 알맞은 장소를 골라요

items.q: Right where the speaker stands: ___에 앉으세요 (Sit here) →
Where the listener is: ___는 날씨가 어때요? (How is the weather there?) →
Far spot across the road: ___에 편의점이 있어요 (Over there) →
Getting the attention of someone far away: ___요! (Excuse me!) →
Come toward the speaker: ___로 오세요 (Come this way) →

title.en: Practice C: Choose the spoken contraction

items.q: What is this? (subject): ___ 뭐예요? (이게 / 이건) →
As for this, it is my notebook (topic): ___ 제 공책이에요 (이게 / 이건) →
Please give me this (object): ___ 주세요 (이걸 / 이게) →
That is a great idea! (subject): ___ 좋은 생각이에요! (그게 / 그걸) →
Look at that over there! (object): ___ 보세요 (저걸 / 저게) →

title.en: Practice D: Complete the demonstrative sentence

items.q: Who is that person over there?: ___ 사람은 누구예요? (이 / 그 / 저) →
How much is this pencil in my hand?: ___ 연필 얼마예요? (이 / 그 / 저) →
Did you like the movie you watched?: ___ 영화 재미있었어요? (이 / 그 / 저) →
The restroom is over there: 화장실은 ___에 있어요 (여기 / 거기 / 저기) →
Please show me that one near you: ___ 좀 보여 주세요 (이것 / 그것) →

howto: Master the 3 distance zones: 이 (close to speaker), 그 (close to listener / previously mentioned), and 저 (distant from both).
Familiarize yourself with the spoken short forms: 이게 (이것이), 이건 (이것은), and 이걸 (이것을).
Complete Practice A to D and check your answers with the answer key.
koSummary: 화자와 청자의 거리에 따른 이·그·저의 기준, 사물(이것·그것·저것)과 장소(여기·거기·저기) 지시 표현, 그리고 실생활에서 널리 쓰이는 줄임말(이게, 이건, 이걸)을 정리했습니다.
